description: This file defines the Style class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages cell styling including font, fill, borders, alignment, number formatting, and protection. It provides methods to apply styles, retrieve style components, and generate style hashes, serving as a core component for spreadsheet cell styling.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Represents cell style management in PhpSpreadsheet, allowing detailed styling of spreadsheet cells including application of style arrays, hashing for style comparison, and handling of style components such as font, fill, borders, etc.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared style component for the current cell, based on active sheet and cell reference.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent Spreadsheet object, used for style supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array to the current style, supporting range and cell-specific styling, with advanced border handling.

methods.name: getOldXfIndexes
methods.description: Helper to obtain existing style indexes for columns, rows, or cells before applying new styles.

methods.name: getFill
methods.description: Returns the Fill component of the style.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the Font component of the style.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the Font component of the style.

methods.name: getBorders
methods.description: Returns the Borders component of the style.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Returns the Alignment component of the style.

methods.name: getNumberFormat
methods.description: Returns the NumberFormat component of the style.

methods.name: getConditionalStyles
methods.description: Retrieves conditional styles applied to the active cell (supervisor only).

methods.name: setConditionalStyles
methods.description: Sets conditional styles for the selected cells (supervisor only).

methods.name: getProtection
methods.description: Returns the Protection component of the style.

methods.name: getQuotePrefix
methods.description: Gets whether quote prefix is used for the style.

methods.name: setQuotePrefix
methods.description: Sets whether quote prefix is used.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a unique hash code representing the current style state for comparison.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the style's index within the style collection.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the style's index within the style collection.
